title: Interactive Spectroscopy Peak Viewer with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive spectroscopy peak viewer with full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Use an orthographic camera looking down the -Z axis, positioned so the spectrum chart fills the viewport.
- Background color: #0a0a1a (dark navy). Add subtle grid lines on the XZ plane using THREE.GridHelper or custom lines (color #1a1a3a).
- The spectrum is rendered as a 3D line/tube geometry in the XY plane. X-axis represents wavenumber (4000 cm⁻¹ on the left to 400 cm⁻¹ on the right, typical IR spectrum). Y-axis represents transmittance (0% bottom to 100% top).
- Generate a synthetic IR spectrum with exactly 6 predefined absorption peaks at wavenumbers: [3400, 2950, 1720, 1450, 1250, 800] cm⁻¹ with transmittance dips to [15, 30, 10, 45, 35, 25]% respectively. Use Gaussian curves (sigma=40) summed together, baseline at 95% transmittance.
- Render the spectrum curve as a bright cyan THREE.Line (color #00ffcc) with ~1000 sample points.
- Draw X and Y axes as white lines with tick marks and labels (use THREE.Sprite or CSS2DRenderer for labels). X-axis label: 'Wavenumber (cm⁻¹)', Y-axis label: 'Transmittance (%)'.

## Peak Markers
- Each of the 6 peaks has a small red sphere (radius 0.08) marker placed at the peak minimum position on the curve.
- Peaks are numbered 1-6 from left to right (highest to lowest wavenumber).
- The currently selected peak has its marker turn yellow and scale up to 1.5x. Only one peak can be selected at a time.
- A vertical dashed line (yellow, using THREE.LineDashedMaterial) extends from the selected peak marker down to the X-axis.

## HUD / DOM UI
- Top-left panel (DOM overlay, id='info-panel'): shows 'Peak [N]: [wavenumber] cm⁻¹, [transmittance]% T' for the selected peak. If no peak selected, show 'No peak selected'.
- Top-right panel (id='history-panel'): shows 'History: [currentIndex]/[totalSteps]' and 'Undo (Ctrl+Z) | Redo (Ctrl+Y)'.
- Bottom bar with 6 buttons (id='peak-btn-1' through 'peak-btn-6') to select peaks by clicking. The active peak's button gets a yellow border.
- A 'Delete Peak' button (id='delete-btn') that removes the currently selected peak from the spectrum (recalculates the curve without that Gaussian). Disabled when no peak selected.
- An 'Add Peak' button (id='add-btn') that enters 'add mode'. In add mode, clicking on the spectrum chart area places a new peak at the clicked wavenumber with transmittance dip to 20%. The button text changes to 'Adding... (click chart)' while in add mode.
- A 'Reset All' button (id='reset-btn') that restores the original 6 peaks.

## Undo/Redo System
- Every state-changing action (select peak, delete peak, add peak, reset) pushes a snapshot onto an undo stack.
- Ctrl+Z undoes the last action, Ctrl+Y redoes. The history panel updates accordingly.
- The undo stack stores full peak arrays (deep copies). Max 50 history entries.
- Undo/redo must restore: peak list, selected peak index, and the rendered spectrum curve.

## Keyboard Interactions
- Left/Right arrow keys: cycle through peaks (select next/previous peak in wavenumber order).
- Delete key: same as clicking 'Delete Peak' button.
- Ctrl+Z: undo. Ctrl+Y: redo.
- Escape: deselect current peak, exit add mode if active.

## Mouse Interactions
- Click on a peak marker sphere (raycasting) to select it.
- Click on the chart area in add mode to place a new peak.
- Hover over a peak marker to show a tooltip (CSS div, id='tooltip') with peak info.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- peaks: array of objects [{wavenumber: number, transmittance: number}] for all current peaks, sorted by wavenumber descending.
- selectedPeakIndex: number (-1 if none selected, 0-based index into peaks array).
- selectedWavenumber: number or null (wavenumber of selected peak).
- selectedTransmittance: number or null (transmittance of selected peak).
- peakCount: number of current peaks.
- undoStackSize: number of entries in undo stack.
- redoStackSize: number of entries in redo stack.
- historyIndex: current position in history (0-based).
- addMode: boolean (true when in add-peak mode).
- curvePointCount: number of sample points in the rendered spectrum curve.
- spectrumBounds: {xMin: 400, xMax: 4000, yMin: 0, yMax: 100}.
- lastAction: string describing last action ('select', 'delete', 'add', 'reset', 'undo', 'redo', 'deselect', 'init').
- peakMarkersVisible: number of visible peak marker meshes in the scene.
- deletedPeaksTotal: cumulative count of peaks deleted this session.
- addedPeaksTotal: cumulative count of peaks added this session.
physics_constraints: Gaussian peak model: each peak contributes a dip of (baseline - transmittance) * exp(-0.5 * ((x - wavenumber) / sigma)^2) where sigma=40. Transmittance values must be clamped to [0, 100]. Wavenumber domain is [400, 4000]. Peak positions must be NaN-free. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states with zero drift. The curve must always have exactly curvePointCount sample points regardless of peak count.
